title: telemetry-sprint-surge-sync-2026-10-14
content:
Purpose:
Quick sync to triage telemetry anomalies seen during last night's staggered canary and align on action items for the midday surge rehearsal. Informal capture — will tidy into the rollout runbook after follow-ups.

Attendees:
- Jenna Kim (notes)
- Marco Rivera (analytics)
- Aisha Patel (frontend)
- Omar Chen (sre)
- Priya Kapoor (product)
- Liam O'Connor (UX researcher)

Timebox: 30m standup style.

High-level summary:
- Canary 3 (panel-experiments) saw a 12% increased p50 latency for panel render pipeline between 01:14–01:22 UTC; throughput stayed stable.
- Analytics event ingestion backlog spiked by ~1.8k events/min for 9 minutes (ingest latency increase), correlated with a schema-change rollout in the analytics-proxy (PR 927).
- UX telemetry sampling bug surfaced where some impression events lacked route tags — impacts A/B metric alignment.

Observations / initial hypotheses:
- Marco: spike aligns exactly with analytics-proxy deploy (GH PR 927). The proxy introduced one additional DB lookup in the happy-path; caches warmed slowly under burst.
- Omar: no infra CPU/GPU spikes on panel hosts, but a small GC pause pattern on the analytics-proxy pods. Pod restart frequency increased ~0.5% during window.
- Aisha: front-end traces show delayed postMessage acknowledgements to the telemetry bridge; the UI continued rendering but telemetry ack delayed, so the SDK retried which increased load to the proxy.
- Priya: product noticed a small increase in perceived latency on canary users; not immediately user-facing but worth gating on.

Decisions made in-sync:
1) Rollback analytics-proxy change in canary (INF-4821) to the previous image for immediate relief. Omar to trigger rollback and monitor (action).
2) Temporarily raise ingress rate limiter for telemetry bridge to prevent client-side retries from magnifying the proxy load while we analyze root cause. Aisha/Omar to coordinate config change.
3) Add quick health check to proxy that rejects requests when DB lookup latency > 150ms so downstream clients can fallback to cached path (short-term circuit). Marco to post a brief implementation note and target a patch today.
4) Create a short postmortem draft and include a prompt-runner test in CI that simulates rapid impression bursts to catch retry-amplification regressions. Jenna to start the draft and link to confluence.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Omar Chen: rollback analytics-proxy in canary, watch for p50 recovery, post rollback note in #console-ops (ETA: 10m) — DONE 01:42 UTC.
- Marco Rivera: dig deeper on DB lookup introduced by PR 927, capture flamegraphs and slow traces, add cache warm-up metrics (ETA: EOD 2026-10-14).
- Aisha Patel: patch SDK to add exponential backoff on telemetry POST retries (lightweight) and ship canary build to staging (ETA: 2026-10-16).
- Priya Kapoor: update rollout gating checklist to include telemetry sampling verification and add manual hold condition when ingest queue > 1k/min (ETA: 2026-10-15).
- Jenna Kim: create the postmortem skeleton and link related artifacts (JIRA INF-4821, GH PR 927) in Confluence (ETA: 2026-10-14 close-of-day).
- Liam O'Connor: run quick UX metric reconciliation for the affected A/B cohorts and flag any drift (ETA: 2026-10-16).

Blockers / open questions:
- Is the added DB lookup necessary in the long term? Marco to propose alternative (in-memory cache per instance).
- Can we get an emergency hotpath bypass in the proxy (config toggle) without a full rollback for faster response next time? Omar to prototype.
- Which rollout windows should be reserved for telemetry-affecting changes? Priya suggests mid-week low-traffic windows; team to codify in the runbook.

Quick notes to self / follow-ups:
- Add a small synthetic test to our canary plan that fires 2k impressions/min for 10m to catch retry amplification (CI + staging).
- Consider adding an ingest-queue length metric to the console rollout dashboard (frontend panel) so PMs can see immediate impact.
- Re-run the UX sample mapping once Aisha pushes the SDK backoff patch.

Links referenced during the call:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/telemetry-rollout-guidance
- GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/927
- JIRA: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4821

Closing / next sync:
- We agreed to reconvene if any regression appears after rollback (monitoring window 60m). Otherwise, follow-ups will be async and we do a quick readout in tomorrow's morning ops sync.

Status log (ongoing):
- 01:42 UTC: Omar rolled back proxy on canary — ingest queue fell back to baseline within 4m.
- 02:00 UTC: Marco posted initial traces to the shared folder; Jenna started postmortem doc.

Misc scratch (notes-to-self):
- Tag the postmortem with "telemetry-amplification".
- Add a short blurb in the runbook about safe telemetry schema rollouts (include feature-flagging the lookup).

---
Document drafted quickly in drive; will be cleaned and moved into the formal runbook / postmortem page.
